_note: remove_b (20 s limit) is due from t=1 but held from t=2 to t=30 while module A is out. Active time = 1 s + (t - 30), so it crosses 20 s at t=49. Nothing may fire during A's 28 s out of the box. remove_b is finally done at t=55 (late: the alert has already fired, and completing it does not fire again). The t=55 event also makes the harness tick timeouts between 30 and 55; with no later event it checks only once, at clip end.
